title: Union contract and litigation settlement approved
subtitle: Special meeting also set closed session items and noted a June 13 joint meeting with Region and area councils.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on June 2, 2025. After a recess for a closed session, members returned and approved two items that came out of that session.

The first approved a Memorandum of Settlement establishing the 2025-2029 Collective Agreement with IBEW 636. The Mayor and Clerk are authorized to sign the documents, which sets labour terms for the covered City employees through 2029 {{vote:m2}}.

The second authorized the General Manager of Infrastructure Services to approve and sign a settlement in a court matter, following direction given in closed session and to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor {{vote:m3}}. The minutes do not describe the terms.

The Mayor also noted that Kitchener councillors are invited to a joint meeting with the Region of Waterloo and all area municipal councils on Friday, June 13, starting about 2:30 p.m. The location was still being finalized. No delegations appeared, and the meeting adjourned at 7:30 p.m.

decisions.detail: Council approved the Memorandum of Settlement dated May 14, 2025 for the 2025-2029 Collective Agreement with IBEW 636 and authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign the documents.

Council authorized the General Manager of Infrastructure Services to approve and sign minutes of settlement in a court file, in line with closed-session direction and to the City Solicitor's satisfaction.

debate: The transcript records no substantive debate. The Mayor asked for discussion on both items and none was recorded.
No delegations were registered and no written comments were noted for this meeting.
The Mayor said the June 13 joint meeting would include all seven area municipal councils and the Region, with the location still to be confirmed.
